title: Design and installation.
officialText:
The applicant shall select and design any such exterior mechanical equipment in order to
achieve compliance with the applicable requirements of Sections 24-218, 24-227, 24-228 and 24-232 of the Administrative
Code, also known as the New York City Noise Control Code, in accordance with generally acceptable engineering practices.
